args.title: Persist selected export format in localStorage in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Update ExportButton to initialize and persist the selected export format in localStorage so it remembers the user's last choice across sessions.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton uses useState with defaultFormat = "csv" and does not save the chosen format to localStorage or sessionStorage when it changes. We should update ExportButton to initialize and persist the selected export format in localStorage so it remembers the user's last choice across sessions.
